Pendent · Standard or Quick Response

Dry Pendent Fire Sprinklers

A DN15 / ½ in dry-barrel sprinkler series available with standard-response or quick-response glass bulbs. Standard overall lengths are 100 mm and 145 mm, with custom lengths reviewed from an 80 mm minimum.

K5.6 US / K80 MetricDN15 / ½ in68°C / 155°F100 / 145 mmCustom Length

Overall length is measured end-to-end across the complete sprinkler assembly. Final length, thread and escutcheon configuration are confirmed against the approved order.
